title: Freeze Allowances across the Linden Memberships Tiers
content:
Whether a Linden Memberships tier may be frozen, for how long, with how much notice and at what freeze fee is fixed per tier. The allowance is counted per membership year, which runs from one activation anniversary to the next; the notice is counted in calendar days before the freeze starts; and the freeze fee (a holding fee) is billed for each frozen month instead of dues.

## Quick reference

| Tier | Freeze permitted | Most months frozen per membership year | Notice before the freeze starts (days) | Freeze fee per frozen month, the holding fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Linden Connect Virtual Membership | No | 0 | 0 | 0.00 |
| Linden Essential Membership | Yes | 2 | 7 | 10.00 |
| Linden Family Membership | Yes | 2 | 7 | 20.00 |
| Linden Plus Membership | Yes | 3 | 7 | 15.00 |
| Linden Premier Concierge Membership | Yes | 3 | 7 | 25.00 |
| Linden Executive Health Membership | No | 0 | 0 | 0.00 |

## Questions the table answers

**Can a Linden Connect Virtual Membership or a Linden Executive Health Membership be frozen?**
No. Neither tier permits a freeze; the zero figures in their rows reflect that.

**How many months may a Linden Plus Membership be frozen?**
Up to 3 months in each membership year, with at least 7 days' notice, at 15.00 for each frozen month.

**What does a two-month freeze of a Linden Family Membership cost?**
The freeze fee is 20.00 per frozen month, so two frozen months are billed 20.00 each, 40.00 in all, in place of the dues for those months. Two months is also the most the tier allows in one membership year.

**Hypothetical: a Linden Essential Membership has already been frozen for 2 months in the current membership year.** The tier's allowance of 2 months for that membership year is used up.
